refs.html: Han-wei Ho, Keng-Wei Fan, Kuan-ting Chen (2026). Detecting Noise-Based Arbitrariness: A Machine-Learning Analysis of Capital Case Sentencing. SSRN working paper 6752624. link
refs.authors: Han-wei Ho, Keng-Wei Fan, Kuan-ting Chen
refs.title: Detecting Noise-Based Arbitrariness: A Machine-Learning Analysis of Capital Case Sentencing
refs.finding: Frames arbitrariness as noise rather than demographic bias; notes prior Taiwan literature found no obvious demographic bias in death sentencing. Similar cases that sit close on the similarity map but receive different outcomes give 'prima facie reason to suspect potential arbitrariness'.
refs.factor: Judicial 'noise' / arbitrariness (unequal treatment of like cases)
refs.status: Working paper; the SSRN page returned 403, so details come from search snippets and the conference abstract.

refs.html: 王金壽 (Chin-Shou Wang), 魏宏儒 (2012). 台灣地方法院裁判評議制度之實證研究 (An Empirical Study of Judicial Deliberation in District Courts in Taiwan). Taiwan: A Radical Quarterly in Social Studies (台灣社會研究季刊) 88: 127-169. link
refs.authors: 王金壽 (Chin-Shou Wang), 魏宏儒
refs.title: 台灣地方法院裁判評議制度之實證研究 (An Empirical Study of Judicial Deliberation in District Courts in Taiwan)
refs.venue: Taiwan: A Radical Quarterly in Social Studies (台灣社會研究季刊) 88: 127-169
refs.finding: How deliberation works in practice varies with judges' deliberation experience, the culture of each courtroom (庭風), and performance-evaluation (考績) pressure. Deliberation is closed to public scrutiny despite its accountability function.
refs.factor: Panel deliberation practice; courtroom culture; performance-evaluation pressure

refs.html: Ching-fang Hsu (2025). Women Judges in a Masculine Court: How Judicial Authority, Legal Area and the Image of the Ideal Judge are Gendered in the Taiwanese Judiciary. Cornell International Law Journal 56(2). link
refs.authors: Ching-fang Hsu
refs.title: Women Judges in a Masculine Court: How Judicial Authority, Legal Area and the Image of the Ideal Judge are Gendered in the Taiwanese Judiciary
refs.finding: Reports that women now hold more than 50% of judicial positions at all three court levels in Taiwan, and documents women judges' experiences. Qualitative; no outcome analysis.
refs.factor: Judge gender (composition and experience of women judges)
refs.status: Title not captured; verify before citing.

refs.html: 蔡劭偉 (Shao-Wei Tsai); advisor 林明仁 Ming-Jen Lin, co-advisor 樊家忠 Elliott Fan (2022). 論我國地方法院判決數量與品質間之關係 (Do more verdicts lead to higher reversal rate in Taiwan's district court?). Master's thesis, Graduate Institute of Economics, National Taiwan University. link
refs.authors: 蔡劭偉 (Shao-Wei Tsai); advisor 林明仁 Ming-Jen Lin, co-advisor 樊家忠 Elliott Fan
refs.title: 論我國地方法院判決數量與品質間之關係 (Do more verdicts lead to higher reversal rate in Taiwan's district court?)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Graduate Institute of Economics, National Taiwan University
refs.finding: Judges issue many more verdicts near month-end. Month-end verdicts were NOT more likely to be appealed or reversed by the High Court (a null result on quality). The author infers that judges pick simpler, clearer cases at month-end. After controlling for covariates and trial length, month-end verdicts carried SHORTER sentences.

refs.factor: Extraneous/institutional: month-end case-clearance pressure. Judicial Yuan rules count each judge's pending cases monthly, with the count closing at month-end
refs.status: Unpublished thesis; no replication found. Quality is measured by appeal and reversal, which Lin & Chang (2025) show is itself affected by judge networks

refs.html: Han-Wei Ho 何漢葳 (Academia Sinica IIAS), Keng-Wei Fan 范耕維 (National Dong Hwa Univ.), Kuan-Ting Chen 陳冠廷 (Cornell Law School) (2025). Exploring Arbitrariness in Sentencing for Murder in Taiwan, 2013-2024. Conference paper posted for CSA 2025 (www3.stat.sinica.edu.tw/csa2025). link
refs.corrections: Venue: a one-page abstract (not a full paper) for the 2025 statistics conference 114年統計學術研討會 (CSAT 2025), held 16 Dec 2025 at Academia Sinica, Taipei; the PDF is posted on the conference site. Affiliations as printed: (1) Institutum Iurisprudentiae, Academia Sinica; (2) Department of Law, National Dong Hwa University; (3) Cornell Law School. Suggested finding wording: the paper runs regressions on legally irrelevant demographic factors, then uses UMAP to map case similarity and flags pairs of near-identical cases that got different sentences. The authors conclude their results 'provide prima facie reason to suspect potential arbitrariness'. The abstract gives no regression results and no counts of such cases.
refs.authors: Han-Wei Ho 何漢葳 (Academia Sinica IIAS), Keng-Wei Fan 范耕維 (National Dong Hwa Univ.), Kuan-Ting Chen 陳冠廷 (Cornell Law School)
refs.title: Exploring Arbitrariness in Sentencing for Murder in Taiwan, 2013-2024
refs.finding: Per the abstract, the results 'provide prima facie reason to suspect potential arbitrariness' in murder sentencing: cases close together in feature space received markedly different sentences. Specific coefficients were not available in the material read (abstract only).
refs.factor: Inter-judge/inter-case arbitrariness, demographic disparities, death penalty
refs.status: Working paper / conference abstract; not yet peer-reviewed

refs.html: 余麗貞 (Li-Chen Yu); advisor 洪永泰 (2010). 臺灣地區殺人案件量刑因素之研究 (A Study of Criminal Sentencing on Homicide Cases in Taiwan). Master's thesis, Dept. of Political Science, National Taiwan University. link
refs.authors: 余麗貞 (Li-Chen Yu); advisor 洪永泰
refs.title: 臺灣地區殺人案件量刑因素之研究 (A Study of Criminal Sentencing on Homicide Cases in Taiwan)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Dept. of Political Science, National Taiwan University
refs.finding: Statutory aggravation (recidivism, minor victims) had no visible effect on sentences. Of 12 non-statutory factors, only defendant age, defendant gender and the judge's court had any influence, all small with weak explanatory power. Statutory sentencing factors (motive, method, victim attitude) mattered. Statutory mitigation had the largest effect (R²=0.496): judges appear to halve the sentence and then adjust it slightly, rather than mitigate in proportion to the circumstances. The abstract reports no results for judge gender, age or seniority.
refs.factor: Defendant, offence, victim and judge-factor groups (including the court)
refs.status: Thesis; descriptive, with no judge fixed effects

refs.html: 曾怡鳳 (Yi-Feng Tseng); advisor 陳鎮洲 Jenn-Jou Chen (2021). 影響法官量刑因素之研究—以槍砲彈藥刀械管制條例為例 (The Determinants of Judges' Sentencing Decisions: A Study of Controlling Guns, Ammunition and Knives Act in Taiwan). Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Chengchi University (written in English). link
refs.authors: 曾怡鳳 (Yi-Feng Tseng); advisor 陳鎮洲 Jenn-Jou Chen
refs.title: 影響法官量刑因素之研究—以槍砲彈藥刀械管制條例為例 (The Determinants of Judges' Sentencing Decisions: A Study of Controlling Guns, Ammunition and Knives Act in Taiwan)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Chengchi University (written in English)
refs.finding: With case facts controlled, judge gender was significant: male judges imposed prison terms about 1.3 months longer than female judges on average. Region was significant: courts in special municipalities imposed terms about 1.4 months shorter. The abstract does not report the gender-ratio result.

refs.status: Thesis; single offence type and single year; not replicated

refs.html: 沈幼蓀、鄭政松 (2016). 終極裁判：《刑法》第57條之外的量刑判準 (To Live or Let Die: An Exploration of Homicide Sentencing in Taiwan). 社會分析 (Social Analysis) No. 12 (Feb 2016), pp. 113-143; DOI 10.3966/221866892016020012003. link
refs.authors: 沈幼蓀、鄭政松
refs.title: 終極裁判：《刑法》第57條之外的量刑判準 (To Live or Let Die: An Exploration of Homicide Sentencing in Taiwan)
refs.finding: Beyond statutory factors, extra-legal characteristics were significantly associated with a death (vs life) sentence: an urban crime location, a female victim, and a victim under 18 or over 70. The number of victims was a decisive factor. The authors argue that simply giving judges more 'social experience' is not obviously the right reform, because social factors already visibly shape sentences.

refs.html: 蔡維哲 (Wei-Che Tsai); advisor 林明仁 Ming-Jen Lin (2018). 論中華民國九十六年罪犯減刑條例對法官量刑的影響 (Does Commutation Policy Aggravate Judge's Sentencing?). Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Taiwan University. link
refs.authors: 蔡維哲 (Wei-Che Tsai); advisor 林明仁 Ming-Jen Lin
refs.title: 論中華民國九十六年罪犯減刑條例對法官量刑的影響 (Does Commutation Policy Aggravate Judge's Sentencing?)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Taiwan University
refs.finding: Judges offset the mandated halving by lengthening sentences about 30-40 days (17-22%) in six-month theft cases. The offset was larger for more serious thefts. The author reads this as judges balancing a preferred sentence against the risk of provoking appeals.
refs.factor: Judges' strategic response to a legal shock (2007 Criminal Commutation Act)
refs.status: Thesis. Replicated in direction, with different magnitudes, by Huang (2023)

refs.html: 黃意婷 (Yi-Ting Huang); advisor 樊家忠 Elliott Fan (2023). 司法或正義？法官對減刑條例的判刑變化 (Law or Justice? Judges' Responses to Commutation). Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Taiwan University. link
refs.authors: 黃意婷 (Yi-Ting Huang); advisor 樊家忠 Elliott Fan
refs.title: 司法或正義？法官對減刑條例的判刑變化 (Law or Justice? Judges' Responses to Commutation)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Taiwan University
refs.finding: For eligible thefts, judges raised sentences by about 43.29 days (24.7%) ('sentence aggravation'). For ineligible thefts committed after the cutoff, they lowered sentences by about 18.26 days (12.5%) ('sentence mitigation'), narrowing the gap between the two groups. The effects lasted at least six months. Both behaviours correlate with the average severity of other judges in the same court, suggesting peer effects.
refs.factor: Strategic sentencing; peer effects within a court
refs.status: Thesis; partial replication and extension of Tsai (2018)

refs.html: 趙仁馨 (Jen-Hsin Chao); advisor 駱明慶 Ming-Ching Luoh (2026). 犯罪數與宣告刑總和對執行刑訂定的影響 (The Effect of the Number of Crimes and the Sum of Declared Sentences on the Executed Sentence in Taiwan). Master's thesis, Dept. of Economics, National Taiwan University (AY 114-1). link

refs.finding: Prosecutors and judges largely agree on which homicide factors matter (premeditation, injury, abuse before killing, corpse disposal). refs.html: 李秀如 (2020). 從性侵害案件判決看司法對婦女人身安全的保護. 社區發展季刊 No. 171 (Sept 2020). link
refs.corrections: Bibliographic fields are correct: 李秀如 (慈濟大學社會工作學系副教授), 社區發展季刊 171期, 民國109年9月 (Sept 2020), pp. 255-271. Corrected finding: The sample is a single court (Hualien District Court): 39 convictions and 41 sentences, one year either side of 7 Aug 2018 (20 sentences after, 21 before). Before the cutoff, 82% of sentences were below, at, or within 5 months above the statutory minimum; after it, 75%. Sentences below the minimum rose from 10% to 20%. Art. 59 mitigation rose from 10% to 20% of all sentences, and Art. 74 probation from 33% to 55%. So mitigation and probation became MORE common after the reform. The author concludes that the second-wave reforms did not change courts' lenient habits, and notes that results may not generalize beyond Hualien. Prior critiques: the 'more than two-thirds of sentences near the statutory minimum' figure comes from the NGO 正義聯盟 (2011) report, not from the Judicial Yuan. The Judicial Yuan's 2011 study (as reported by 林錦芳 2011, 刑事法雜誌 55:17-40) found that judges anchor on the statutory minimum, that reductions exceed aggravations, and that Art. 57 factors are reused to justify Art. 59.

refs.finding: Sentences changed little across the cutoff and stayed near statutory minimums. Use of Art. 59 mitigation and probation persisted (around 20% in some categories after the cutoff). The author concludes that lenient sentencing persisted despite the reforms. Also summarizes prior critiques (2011 Judicial Yuan analysis and NGO reports) that two-thirds of sentences sat near the minimum.
refs.factor: Effect of sentencing reforms (sentencing info system, 2018 guidelines) on sexual-offence leniency

refs.corrections: Bibliographic fields are correct: Mong-Hwa Chin, Asian Journal of Law and Society 6(1): 181-207, May 2019 (online 30 Apr 2019), DOI 10.1017/als.2019.8. Corrected finding: a qualitative study of four mock trials at four district courts (observation and interviews), set against the 2012 Observer Jury and 2018 Lay Judge proposals. It identifies three problems: professional judges dominating deliberations, which was observed in BOTH the guilt and sentencing phases; lay judges' difficulty understanding legal language; and the lack of evidence rules. Lay judges had the most difficulty in the sentencing phase, which drew further intervention from professional judges. It recommends training for lay judges and legal professionals, an adjusted discovery rule, sentencing guidance, and evidentiary rules.

refs.finding: Professional judges dominated deliberations, especially on sentencing. Legal language was hard for lay judges to understand, and Taiwan lacked evidence rules. Recommends training, sentencing guidance and evidentiary rules.
refs.factor: Lay vs professional judges in deliberation

refs.html: Yun-chien Chang, Kong-Pin Chen, Jen-Che Liao, Chang-Ching Lin (2023). Ask More, Awarded More: Evidence from Taiwan's Courts. International Review of Law and Economics 76:106171 (DOI 10.1016/j.irle.2023.106171). link
refs.authors: Yun-chien Chang, Kong-Pin Chen, Jen-Che Liao, Chang-Ching Lin
refs.title: Ask More, Awarded More: Evidence from Taiwan's Courts
refs.venue: International Review of Law and Economics 76:106171 (DOI 10.1016/j.irle.2023.106171)
refs.finding: A plaintiff's claim raises the judge's award even when market evidence does not support the claim. Releasing public price information weakens the effect.
refs.factor: Anchoring on the plaintiff's claim (extraneous, non-merits)

refs.html: Chang-Ching Lin, Yun-chien Chang (2025). Learning or Networking? The Causal Effect of Judges Sitting by Designation. Journal of Legal Studies 54(1):43-81 (DOI 10.1086/734721). link
refs.authors: Chang-Ching Lin, Yun-chien Chang
refs.title: Learning or Networking? The Causal Effect of Judges Sitting by Designation
refs.finding: When an appeal goes to an appellate judge who was formerly a colleague of the district-court author, reversal rates drop significantly (a 'networking effect'). Without a causal design, overall reversal rates are also lower after transitory promotions, which is consistent with a 'learning effect'.
refs.factor: Judge-side: collegial networks and familiarity between appellate and trial judges

refs.html: Patrick C. Wu, Chang-Ching Lin, Yun-chien Chang (2026). How Judges' Social Identity Impacts Reversal Decisions: Evidence from the Transitory Promotion of Judges. Journal of Law, Economics, and Organization, advance article ewag022 (published online 26 May 2026). link
refs.authors: Patrick C. Wu, Chang-Ching Lin, Yun-chien Chang
refs.title: How Judges' Social Identity Impacts Reversal Decisions: Evidence from the Transitory Promotion of Judges
refs.venue: Journal of Law, Economics, and Organization, advance article ewag022 (published online 26 May 2026)
refs.finding: Temporarily promoted judges reverse less often, and judges favor the district courts where they previously served. The authors argue social identity is the likely key explanation, and that the dataset's size and random case allocation support generalising the findings. (Presented at Stanford FSI in May 2025 as 'Familiarity Breeds Contempt or Deference?')
refs.factor: Judge-side social identity (home-court in-group favoritism)

refs.html: Kong-Pin Chen, Kuo-Chang Huang, Chang-Ching Lin (2015). Party Capability versus Court Preference: Why Do the 'Haves' Come Out Ahead? An Empirical Lesson from the Taiwan Supreme Court. Journal of Law, Economics, & Organization 31(1):93-126. link
refs.authors: Kong-Pin Chen, Kuo-Chang Huang, Chang-Ching Lin
refs.title: Party Capability versus Court Preference: Why Do the 'Haves' Come Out Ahead? An Empirical Lesson from the Taiwan Supreme Court
refs.finding: Higher-status litigants had stronger legal representation and won more often, but party capability alone does not explain their advantage. The Supreme Court's discretionary jurisdiction strongly favored governmental litigants at the agenda-setting stage, which the authors attribute to the judges' self-identification as part of government. Both party capability and court preference shape appeal outcomes.
refs.factor: Litigant identity (government vs private; 'haves' vs 'have-nots'); court self-identification with government
refs.status: Published. The finding is taken from abstract-level search results; full text not read.

refs.html: 鄭宇翔 Yu-Hsiang Cheng (advisor: Kong-Pin Chen) (2015). 法庭偏好是否影響判決結果？——來自台灣最高法院案例的實證分析 (Does Court Preference Have an Impact on the Judgement? The Case of the Taiwan Supreme Court). Master's thesis, Department of Economics, National Taiwan University. link
refs.authors: 鄭宇翔 Yu-Hsiang Cheng (advisor: Kong-Pin Chen)
refs.title: 法庭偏好是否影響判決結果？——來自台灣最高法院案例的實證分析 (Does Court Preference Have an Impact on the Judgement? The Case of the Taiwan Supreme Court)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Department of Economics, National Taiwan University
refs.finding: Court preference matters beyond litigant resource gaps. A more senior presiding judge significantly lowers the rate at which appeals are granted, and judges of different seniority favor different appellant types to different degrees.
refs.factor: Judge seniority × appellant type

refs.html: 黃國昌 Kuo-Chang Huang (2008). 我國勞動訴訟之實證研究──以第一審訴訟之審理與終結情形為中心（上）(An Empirical Study on Labor Litigation in Taiwan, Part I). 政大法學評論 Chengchi Law Review No. 106, pp. 203-247 (Part II in No. 107, 2009). link
refs.authors: 黃國昌 Kuo-Chang Huang
refs.title: 我國勞動訴訟之實證研究──以第一審訴訟之審理與終結情形為中心（上）(An Empirical Study on Labor Litigation in Taiwan, Part I)
refs.venue: 政大法學評論 Chengchi Law Review No. 106, pp. 203-247 (Part II in No. 107, 2009)
refs.finding: Labor cases were not slower than ordinary property cases. Labor plaintiffs' win rates were not markedly lower than other money-claim plaintiffs (an English abstract says labor plaintiffs won far more often than employer defendants at trial). Losing workers filed many low-merit appeals. Courts with specialized labor divisions did not outperform courts without them on duration, appeal rate or affirmance rate.
refs.factor: Court and institutional differences (specialized labor divisions 勞工專庭); litigant type (worker vs employer)
refs.status: Published, peer-reviewed. Predates the 2020 Labor Incident Act.

refs.html: Kuo-Chang Huang, Kong-Pin Chen, Chang-Ching Lin (2010). An Empirical Investigation of Settlement and Litigation: The Case of Taiwanese Labor Disputes. Journal of Empirical Legal Studies 7(4):786-810. link
refs.authors: Kuo-Chang Huang, Kong-Pin Chen, Chang-Ching Lin
refs.title: An Empirical Investigation of Settlement and Litigation: The Case of Taiwanese Labor Disputes
refs.finding: Larger stakes lower the chance of settlement, reduce the share of the claim recovered in settlement and raise the chance of litigation after talks fail. Threat credibility matters but does not overturn the stakes pattern. Mediation lets small-claim workers recover meaningful amounts. Workers' risk aversion may lower recovery as claims grow.
refs.factor: Litigant circumstances (stakes, threat credibility, risk aversion)

refs.html: Hung-En Liu (劉宏恩) (2001). Mother or Father: Who Received Custody? The Best Interests of the Child Standard and Judges' Custody Decisions in Taiwan. International Journal of Law, Policy and the Family 15(2):185-225. link
refs.authors: Hung-En Liu (劉宏恩)
refs.title: Mother or Father: Who Received Custody? The Best Interests of the Child Standard and Judges' Custody Decisions in Taiwan
refs.venue: International Journal of Law, Policy and the Family 15(2):185-225
refs.finding: After the 1996 reform, mothers received custody far more often than fathers (fathers were favored before 1996). Custody reasoning reflected gender stereotypes, concern for social standing and parental financial-support norms, and regional economic differences mattered. Sole custody predominated.
refs.factor: Judges' cultural assumptions (gender stereotypes, 'face', financial support norms); region

refs.html: 黃詩淳 Sieh-Chuen Huang, 邵軒磊 Hsuan-Lei Shao (2018). 酌定子女親權之重要因素：以決策樹方法分析相關裁判 (What Factors Determine Child Custody in Taiwan? Using Decision Tree Learning on Court Decisions). 臺大法學論叢 NTU Law Journal 47(1):299-344. link
refs.authors: 黃詩淳 Sieh-Chuen Huang, 邵軒磊 Hsuan-Lei Shao
refs.title: 酌定子女親權之重要因素：以決策樹方法分析相關裁判 (What Factors Determine Child Custody in Taiwan? Using Decision Tree Learning on Court Decisions)
refs.venue: 臺大法學論叢 NTU Law Journal 47(1):299-344
refs.finding: Primary caregiver, the child's wishes and parent-child interaction are the three most influential factors. Parents' economic condition was no longer important. Model accuracy was about 94-95%. Judge characteristics were not modelled.
refs.factor: Statutory factors under Civil Code art. 1055-1

refs.html: Hsuan-Lei Shao, Robert B. Leflar, Sieh-Chuen Huang (2022 (online) / 2023 (issue)). Factors Determining Child Custody in Taiwan after Patriarchy's Decline: Decision Tree Analysis on Family Court Decisions. Asian Journal of Comparative Law 18(2):272-288. link
refs.authors: Hsuan-Lei Shao, Robert B. Leflar, Sieh-Chuen Huang
refs.title: Factors Determining Child Custody in Taiwan after Patriarchy's Decline: Decision Tree Analysis on Family Court Decisions
refs.finding: Mothers received sole custody in about 75% of cases, but the authors argue this reflects primary-caregiver status, not maternal preference ('maternal preference is a myth'). Fathers who were primary caregivers won about 85% of the time. Occupation and economic resources were not significant. Test accuracy was 96.5%. The sample excludes defaults, transnational marriages and joint custody.
refs.factor: Parent gender vs caregiving role

refs.html: Yun-Hsien Diana Lin (林昀嫺), Daw-Wei Wang (王道維) (c.2021 (PDF created Nov 2021; data 2015-2017)). 民法親權酌定與改定的量化研究 (Empirical Studies on Judicial Decisions of Child Custody According to Civil Code). National Tsing Hua University research highlight (2-page report). link
refs.authors: Yun-Hsien Diana Lin (林昀嫺), Daw-Wei Wang (王道維)
refs.title: 民法親權酌定與改定的量化研究 (Empirical Studies on Judicial Decisions of Child Custody According to Civil Code)
refs.venue: National Tsing Hua University research highlight (2-page report)
refs.finding: About 63% of mothers received sole custody, 18% fathers and 18% joint custody. A mother petitioner won sole custody about 69% of the time. When the father petitioned, the respondent mother still won about 55%. Top factors were parent-child relations, parental intention and ability, and support system. Financial condition was not decisive.
refs.factor: Parent gender, petitioner role

refs.html: 林至容 Chih-Jung Lin (advisor: 陳明進 Ming-Chin Chen) (2019). 稅務訴訟中法官背景對訴訟結果影響之研究 (The Study on the Effects of Judges' Social Background on Tax Litigation Outcome). Master's thesis, Department of Accounting, National Chengchi University. link
refs.authors: 林至容 Chih-Jung Lin (advisor: 陳明進 Ming-Chin Chen)
refs.title: 稅務訴訟中法官背景對訴訟結果影響之研究 (The Study on the Effects of Judges' Social Background on Tax Litigation Outcome)
refs.venue: Master's thesis, Department of Accounting, National Chengchi University
refs.finding: Judges' social background significantly affects the appellant's (usually the taxpayer's) win rate. The Taxpayer Rights Protection Act had a positive effect on appellant win rates. Specialized tax panels differ significantly from one another, so outcomes depend on panel assignment. The abstract does not specify which background variables were measured.
refs.factor: Judge social background; tax panel identity; Taxpayer Rights Protection Act

refs.html: Judicial Reform Foundation (民間司法改革基金會); comments by 黃世洲, 蔡朝安 (2010). 民間司改會 臺北高等行政法院 監督報告 (news report: Newtalk, 2010-11-30). NGO court-monitoring report, reported by Newtalk. link
refs.corrections: Title: the actual Newtalk headline is '民間監督行政法院 顯示人民勝訴率低' (2010-11-30). The article names the monitored court only as '台北行政法院', the colloquial name for 臺北高等行政法院. Corrected finding: The JRF report found that a few judges lacked diligence, plaintiff win rates were low (no percentage given), cases took too long and the court was understaffed. Some judges were hostile, condescending or impatient, and one judge had the most conduct problems; judges were not named. The German comparison is 黃世洲's comment, not the JRF report itself. He compared the Taipei Administrative Court with German tax courts and said German plaintiffs win 2.5x as often at first instance and 3x as often on appeal. 蔡朝安 analysed 315 randomly sampled judgments for copying of the agency's defense arguments: 2.79% were over 90% similar and 8.25% over 70% similar. He described this as an improvement over the past. '20 judges handle nearly 5,000 cases': the article does NOT say these are tax cases. The sentence appears in a passage on tax-case delays.
refs.authors: Judicial Reform Foundation (民間司法改革基金會); comments by 黃世洲, 蔡朝安
refs.title: 民間司改會 臺北高等行政法院 監督報告 (news report: Newtalk, 2010-11-30)
refs.venue: NGO court-monitoring report, reported by Newtalk
refs.finding: Plaintiff win rates are low. German tax-court plaintiffs win about 2.5 times as often at first instance. About 2.79% of sampled judgments were over 90% similar to the government agency's brief, and 8.25% were over 70% similar. A minority of judges were recorded as hostile or impatient. Roughly 20 judges handled nearly 5,000 tax cases.
refs.factor: Government-litigant advantage; judge demeanor
refs.status: NGO monitoring report, not peer-reviewed. Seen only through the news report.

refs.html: Judicial Yuan (司法院) statistics (2010). 高等行政法院行政訴訟第一審事件終結情形－按性質類別分 (中華民國99年). Judicial Yuan judicial statistics table. link
refs.authors: Judicial Yuan (司法院) statistics
refs.title: 高等行政法院行政訴訟第一審事件終結情形－按性質類別分 (中華民國99年)
refs.finding: 5,598 cases closed: 374 plaintiff wins, 3,499 losses, 194 partly grounded/partly groundless and 3 partly grounded/partly improper (the rest were dismissed by ruling, withdrawn, etc.). By my calculation that is about 9% full wins among merit judgments. Tax: 1,979 closed, 113 wins, 1,474 losses, 84 partial. State compensation in administrative court: 23 closed, 0 wins, 5 losses, 1 partial.
refs.factor: Government vs citizen win rates
refs.status: Official statistics. Comparisons are broken by the 2012 move of simple cases to district courts.

refs.html: Gary Kuo, Yi-Kai Chen (Winkler Partners) (2021). Exploring statistics at the Taiwan Intellectual Property Court: Part IV, administrative litigation. Law-firm analysis. link
refs.authors: Gary Kuo, Yi-Kai Chen (Winkler Partners)
refs.title: Exploring statistics at the Taiwan Intellectual Property Court: Part IV, administrative litigation
refs.finding: Plaintiff win rates in IP Court administrative cases were below 20% in every year since 2008 but one, reaching 23.5% in 2019. Revocation actions fell to 9.9% in 2019, while obligation actions rose to 34.9%.

refs.html: Yun-chien Chang (2014). An Empirical Study of Administrative Appeal in Taiwan. Transnational Law & Contemporary Problems 23(2):261-304. link
refs.authors: Yun-chien Chang
refs.title: An Empirical Study of Administrative Appeal in Taiwan
refs.finding: Findings not retrieved in this sweep; only the bibliographic listing was confirmed. A companion Chinese article proposes an empirical assessment framework for administrative appeal systems (Peking University Law Review 14(2):344-388).
refs.factor: Citizen vs government outcomes in administrative appeal

refs.html: Presenter 范文清; discussants 張升星 (judge), 呂理翔, 張志偉; Judicial Reform Foundation (2023). 研討會記錄場次3｜法官的國家賠償責任 (Seminar record: State compensation liability of judges). Judicial Reform Foundation seminar record (held 26 Aug 2023, posted 5 Oct 2023). link
refs.authors: Presenter 范文清; discussants 張升星 (judge), 呂理翔, 張志偉; Judicial Reform Foundation
refs.title: 研討會記錄場次3｜法官的國家賠償責任 (Seminar record: State compensation liability of judges)
refs.venue: Judicial Reform Foundation seminar record (held 26 Aug 2023, posted 5 Oct 2023)
refs.finding: The presenter reported that citizens' state-compensation claims over judicial conduct have effectively a 0% success rate, with a 1.4% figure for liability established that a judge discussant called inflated. Discussants cautioned that 0% does not by itself prove the art. 13 threshold blocks meritorious claims: cases may instead run through criminal compensation (刑事補償), and the statistics admit several readings.
refs.factor: Citizen vs state; judicial self-protection
refs.status: Seminar record, not peer-reviewed. Underlying study not located.

refs.html: Nuno Garoupa, Veronica Grembi, Shirley Ching-ping Lin (2011). Explaining Constitutional Review in New Democracies: The Case of Taiwan. Pacific Rim Law & Policy Journal (Washington International Law Journal) 20(1):1-40. link
refs.authors: Nuno Garoupa, Veronica Grembi, Shirley Ching-ping Lin
refs.title: Explaining Constitutional Review in New Democracies: The Case of Taiwan
refs.venue: Pacific Rim Law & Policy Journal (Washington International Law Journal) 20(1):1-40
refs.finding: No strong support for the attitudinal hypothesis that justices vote in line with the party that appointed them. The authors argue that during democratization the justices needed to establish independence and credibility, and so dissented more, sometimes against the dominant party.
refs.factor: Appointing-party / attitudinal effects
refs.status: Published. Later challenged by Su, Ho & Lin (2018).

refs.html: Lucia Dalla Pellegrina, Nuno Garoupa, Shirley Ching-ping Lin (2012). Judicial Ideal Points in New Democracies: The Case of Taiwan. National Taiwan University Law Review 7(1):123-165. link
refs.authors: Lucia Dalla Pellegrina, Nuno Garoupa, Shirley Ching-ping Lin
refs.title: Judicial Ideal Points in New Democracies: The Case of Taiwan
refs.finding: No strong evidence of coalitions by appointing president. Apart from a handful of justices, most estimated ideal points are moderate. The paper confirms earlier work largely rejecting the attitudinal hypothesis.
refs.factor: Ideology; appointing-president coalitions
refs.status: Published. A Philippines application by the same team did find appointment blocs.

refs.html: Yen-tu Su (蘇彥圖), Han-wei Ho (何漢葳), Chien-chih Lin (林建志) (2018). Are Taiwan Constitutional Court Justices Political?. Working paper, Comparative Supreme Court Decision Making Workshop, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Dec 2018. link
refs.authors: Yen-tu Su (蘇彥圖), Han-wei Ho (何漢葳), Chien-chih Lin (林建志)
refs.title: Are Taiwan Constitutional Court Justices Political?
refs.venue: Working paper, Comparative Supreme Court Decision Making Workshop, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Dec 2018
refs.finding: Contrary to earlier studies, the authors find circumstantial evidence that ideology plays some role, though most justices are moderate. The political conservatism score is significant in all political cases and in some less-political models. The appointing-president proxy was not significant in the models discussed. Justices with prior judicial careers had about 44% higher odds of upholding the law than academics (one model). US-doctorate justices had lower odds. The later natural courts (2011-2016) were significantly less likely to uphold laws.
refs.factor: Ideology, appointing president, prior judicial career, US doctorate, natural-court period
refs.status: Working paper. Su's CV still lists it as unpublished.

refs.html: 蘇彥圖 Yen-tu Su (2014). 釋憲時刻——初探司法院大法官的議程設定及其憲政效應 (A Time for Constitutional Adjudication: Agenda-Setting in Taiwan's Constitutional Court). 憲政時代 Constitutional Times 39(4):26-69 (DOI 10.3966/101665132014043904002). link
refs.authors: 蘇彥圖 Yen-tu Su
refs.title: 釋憲時刻——初探司法院大法官的議程設定及其憲政效應 (A Time for Constitutional Adjudication: Agenda-Setting in Taiwan's Constitutional Court)
refs.finding: Only a tiny share of petitions reach decision, and when they do is the result of two case-level choices: selecting the case and timing its decision. The author argues the 'semi-discretionary' docket does not reduce selection errors and worsens judicial candor, and recommends full agenda control by the justices.
refs.factor: Decision timing and case-selection discretion

refs.html: Yen-tu Su, Han-wei Ho, Chien-chih Lin (2025). Old Habits, New Law, and the Quest for a More Productive Court: An Early Assessment of the Performance-Enhancing Effects of the Constitutional Court Procedure Act in Taiwan. Taiwan Democracy Quarterly 22(4):47-95. link

refs.title: Old Habits, New Law, and the Quest for a More Productive Court: An Early Assessment of the Performance-Enhancing Effects of the Constitutional Court Procedure Act in Taiwan
refs.finding: Findings not retrieved. The title signals an early assessment of whether the 2022 Act improved productivity, against 'old habits'.
refs.factor: Judicial reform (憲法訴訟法) and court productivity

refs.html: 黃丞儀 Cheng-yi Huang (2025). 台灣民主的潘朵拉盒子──憲法法庭面臨的正當性危機. The Reporter (報導者), opinion, 30 Dec 2025. link
refs.authors: 黃丞儀 Cheng-yi Huang
refs.title: 台灣民主的潘朵拉盒子──憲法法庭面臨的正當性危機
refs.finding: Seven justices left on 31 Oct 2024, leaving 8 of 15 seats. The December 2024 amendment required 10 justices to deliberate and 9 votes to strike a law. The legislature rejected 14 nominees in two rounds. On 19 Dec 2025, 5 justices struck down the quorum rule, while 3 (蔡宗珍, 楊惠欽, 朱富美) refused to take part and called the ruling void. The author warns of politicization and a legitimacy crisis.
refs.factor: Partisan conflict over Constitutional Court composition and quorum

refs.html: Shih-An Wang (2025). The Smoking Gun of Democratic Backsliding? The 2024 Amendment to the Constitutional Court Procedure Act in Taiwan. Taiwan Insight (University of Nottingham Taiwan Studies Programme blog), 15 Jan 2025. link
refs.authors: Shih-An Wang

refs.venue: Taiwan Insight (University of Nottingham Taiwan Studies Programme blog), 15 Jan 2025
refs.finding: The amendment replaced 'half of participating justices' with two-thirds of the statutory 15 (effectively 10 present) and required 9 votes to declare a law unconstitutional. With 8 sitting justices, rulings became unlikely. The author reads this as possible democratic backsliding aimed at the court's independence.

refs.html: Chung-Li Wu (吳重禮), Xiao-Chen Su (蘇曉辰) (2014). Taming the Tongue: Political Resource Inequalities and Court Decisions in Defamation Litigation in Taiwan. Issues & Studies 50(4):157-189. link

refs.title: Taming the Tongue: Political Resource Inequalities and Court Decisions in Defamation Litigation in Taiwan

refs.html: Lucia Dalla Pellegrina, Laarni Escresa, Nuno Garoupa (2014). Measuring Judicial Ideal Points in New Democracies: The Case of the Philippines. Asian Journal of Law and Society 1(1):125-164 (DOI 10.1017/als.2013.8). link

refs.title: Measuring Judicial Ideal Points in New Democracies: The Case of the Philippines

refs.html: Kuo-Chang Huang; Kong-Pin Chen; Chang-Ching Lin (2010). Does the type of criminal defense counsel affect case outcomes? A natural experiment in Taiwan. International Review of Law and Economics 30(2):113-127. link
refs.authors: Kuo-Chang Huang; Kong-Pin Chen; Chang-Ching Lin

refs.finding: Public defenders and government-contracted legal aid attorneys are 'about equally effective', but they use different litigation strategies. Defendants represented by public defenders have higher conviction rates but shorter sentences if convicted. The authors attribute this to institutional differences and pecuniary incentives. The abstract does not report a comparison with privately retained counsel.

refs.html: Kuo-Chang Huang (2008). How Legal Representation Affects Case Outcomes: An Empirical Perspective from Taiwan. Journal of Empirical Legal Studies 5(2):197-238. link
refs.authors: Kuo-Chang Huang
refs.title: How Legal Representation Affects Case Outcomes: An Empirical Perspective from Taiwan
refs.finding: Cases are less likely to settle when both sides have lawyers. Representation has no significant effect on outcomes in cases that go to trial. Huang explains this by litigants' selection into hiring lawyers and by active judges in civil-law adjudication helping self-represented parties. He concludes lawyers' influence in Taiwan may be weaker than in the US. (Abstract read via the OpenAlex record.)

refs.html: Kuo-Chang Huang; Chang-Ching Lin; Kong-Pin Chen (2014). Do Rich and Poor Behave Similarly in Seeking Legal Advice? Lessons from Taiwan in Comparative Perspective. Law & Society Review 48(1):193-223. link

refs.finding: Income is significantly and positively correlated with obtaining legal advice but has no effect on obtaining non-legal advice. Education has little bearing on obtaining legal advice but positively affects seeking non-legal advice. The gravity of the problem matters more than income, but the income effect 'should not be easily dismissed'. The authors recommend more publicly funded advice and better public awareness of it.

refs.html: Yun-chien Chang; Han-wei Ho; Jimmy Chia-Shin Hsu (2016). Non-Pecuniary Damages for Defamation, Personal Injury, and Wrongful Death: An Empirical Analysis of Court Cases in Taiwan. The Chinese Journal of Comparative Law 4(1):69-97. link

refs.html: Yun-chien Chang; Theodore Eisenberg; Han-Wei Ho; Martin T. Wells (2015). Pain and Suffering Damages in Wrongful Death Cases: An Empirical Study. Journal of Empirical Legal Studies 12(1):128-160. link
refs.authors: Yun-chien Chang; Theodore Eisenberg; Han-Wei Ho; Martin T. Wells
refs.title: Pain and Suffering Damages in Wrongful Death Cases: An Empirical Study
refs.finding: The plaintiff's ad damnum significantly influences awards, which may indicate anchoring. Courts are 'very sensitive' to pushing defendants into financial hardship: defendants' out-of-pocket pecuniary damages relative to their income reduce pain-and-suffering awards. Spouses receive more than other next-of-kin, and adult children receive the least.
refs.factor: Litigant: defendant's ability to pay; claimant relationship; anchoring on the plaintiff's ad damnum

refs.html: Ching-Fang Hsu; Ivan Kan-hsueh Chiang; Yun-chien Chang (2024). Lawyers' legal aid participation: A qualitative and quantitative analysis. Journal of Empirical Legal Studies 21(2):337-374. link
refs.authors: Ching-Fang Hsu; Ivan Kan-hsueh Chiang; Yun-chien Chang
refs.title: Lawyers' legal aid participation: A qualitative and quantitative analysis
refs.finding: The authors' theory is that pro bono work signals moral standing, whereas 'low bono' (discounted-price) legal aid attracts less competitive attorneys and is seen as signalling incompetence. The design of a legal aid regime therefore draws lawyers of different quality into the work. The abstract reports no case-outcome results.
refs.factor: Litigant-side: quality and selection of legal aid counsel (法律扶助基金會)

refs.html: Kuo-Chang Huang; Chang-Ching Lin (2013). Rescuing Confidence in the Judicial System: Introducing Lay Participation in Taiwan. Journal of Empirical Legal Studies 10(3):542-569. link
refs.authors: Kuo-Chang Huang; Chang-Ching Lin
refs.title: Rescuing Confidence in the Judicial System: Introducing Lay Participation in Taiwan
refs.finding: Uses Taiwan's 2012 proposal (an advisory jury that decides without judges but is non-binding, i.e. the 觀審制 model) and argues the reform's purpose was restoring public confidence rather than democratizing decision-making. Strong support for citizen participation comes from dissatisfaction with professional judges' decision-making. Only about half the public is willing to serve, with significant demographic disparities in willingness.
refs.factor: Public trust; lay participation (2012 advisory-jury / 觀審制 proposal)

refs.finding: Prosecutors' sentencing requests significantly influenced sentences, possibly through anchoring. Most cases used the statutory range as the main reference, and few used the fact-based sentencing information system. Over 98% of lay judges found evidence procedures easy to understand, and over 95% agreed with the verdict and reasoning. Most said professional judges' presence did not stop them from speaking. After service, 'very high' trust in the judiciary rose 47.2 points. Problems found: inconsistent application of the rules for excluding cases from lay-judge trial (Art. 6 subparas 4-5), and weak pre-sentence evaluation. The summary page gives no conviction-rate or sentence comparison with professional-judge trials.

refs.title: 114年一般民眾對司法認知調查報告 (2025 Survey of Public Perceptions of the Judiciary)
refs.finding: Trust in judges was 59.8% (distrust 31.7%), up from 55.8% in 2024. It was 35.8% in 2016 and 44.6% in 2019, rising to a 58.8% peak in 2022. Younger, more educated and more legally knowledgeable respondents trust more. Agreement: 'most judges sentence criminals appropriately' 65.8%; 'judge according to law' 64.5%; 'judge independently' only 54.2%. Among people unwilling to go to court, 81.3% cite 'may not get a fair ruling' (83.9% among low-knowledge respondents). Court users' satisfaction with judges' credibility was 65.1%. Main information sources are TV (56.5%) and online news (55.3%).

refs.status: Commissioned by the Judicial Yuan itself; question wording differs from academic surveys

refs.authors: 立法院; text via 全國法規資料庫 (法務部)
refs.title: 刑事訴訟法 第33-1、93-2至93-6、101、101-1、116-2條 及 法規沿革
refs.finding: Art. 101 permits detention on grave suspicion plus flight risk, tampering or collusion risk, or a grave offence with reasonable grounds for those risks; detention must be necessary. Since 2017 the facts and evidence must be disclosed, and evidence withheld under 93(2) may not be used. Art. 33-1 (added 2017-04-26) gives defense counsel file access at investigation-stage detention hearings. Arts. 93-2 to 93-6 (added 2019-06-19, effective after 6 months) let prosecutors or judges impose exit and sea-exit restrictions. Art. 101-1 (preventive detention for repeat risk; last amended 2026-05-13) now lists theft, fraud, aggravated fraud and Fraud Crime Hazard Prevention Act offences, among others. Art. 116-2 (amended 2019-07-17 and 2025-11-11) allows release conditions including electronic monitoring, passport surrender and asset-disposal limits. The 'unless necessary' standards leave wide room for judicial judgment.
refs.factor: Legal standards and structural changes for detention, exit restriction and release conditions

refs.title: 刑法 第41條 (易科罰金/易服社會勞動)、第74條 (緩刑); 刑事訴訟法 第309、449、455-2、457、253-1條
refs.finding: Under 刑法§41, a sentence of 6 months or less (or 拘役), for an offence with a maximum of 5 years or less, may be converted to a fine at NT$1,000, 2,000 or 3,000 per day, unless conversion 'cannot achieve correction or maintain legal order'. Community service at 6 hours per day is the fallback. The judgment states only the conversion rate (刑訴§309(2)); execution, and therefore the decision to permit conversion, is directed by the prosecutor (§457). Under 刑法§74, probation is available for sentences of 2 years or less if the record conditions are met and the court 'considers suspension appropriate', with optional conditions (§74(2) items 1-8). Upstream: 緩起訴 by prosecutors (§253-1, for offences without a minimum of 3 years or more); summary judgments limited to probation or convertible sentences (§449); prosecutor-initiated plea bargaining (§455-2).
refs.factor: Allocation of discretion between judges and prosecutors for probation, fine conversion and community service

refs.finding: Detained by the Taipei District Court on 12 Nov 2008. Politicians and defence counsel called the reassignment political interference.

refs.html: Emily Leslie; Nolan G. Pope (2017). The Unintended Impact of Pretrial Detention on Case Outcomes: Evidence from New York City Arraignments. Journal of Law and Economics 60(3): 529-557 (DOI 10.1086/695285). link
refs.authors: Emily Leslie; Nolan G. Pope
refs.title: The Unintended Impact of Pretrial Detention on Case Outcomes: Evidence from New York City Arraignments
refs.finding: Detention raises the probability of conviction for felony defendants by 13 percentage points. It lowers rearrest while the case is pending, but this is mostly offset by more recidivism within 2 years after disposition. Higher detention rates for minority defendants explain 40% of the Black-white gap and 28% of the Hispanic-white gap in prison sentences.
refs.factor: Arraignment-judge stringency; pretrial detention
refs.status: Peer-reviewed; part of a consistent US literature

refs.title: The Heavy Costs of High Bail: Evidence from Judge Randomization
refs.finding: Being assigned money bail raises the likelihood of conviction by 12% and recidivism by 6-9%. The authors point to credit constraints and fairness concerns in money-bail systems.

refs.finding: Pretrial detention raises the likelihood of conviction by 13%, mostly through guilty pleas by defendants who would otherwise have been acquitted or had charges dropped. It also increases incarceration sentence length by 42% and non-bail court fees owed by 41%, which the author describes as a poverty trap.

refs.title: Incarceration, Recidivism, and Employment
refs.finding: Imprisonment reduces reoffending probability by 29 percentage points and charges by 11 over 5 years; OLS gives the opposite sign. The effect comes from people not working before incarceration, who increase program participation and later employment. Previously employed people suffer lasting employment losses.
refs.factor: Judge stringency (incarceration)
refs.status: Peer-reviewed; contrasts with US null and harmful findings

refs.html: Amanda Agan; Jennifer L. Doleac; Anna Harvey (2023). Misdemeanor Prosecution. Quarterly Journal of Economics 138(3): 1453-1505. link
refs.authors: Amanda Agan; Jennifer L. Doleac; Anna Harvey
refs.title: Misdemeanor Prosecution
refs.finding: For the marginal defendant, non-prosecution cuts the likelihood of a new criminal complaint within 2 years by 53% and the number of complaints by 60%. Effects are largest for people without priors, pointing to criminal-record acquisition as a mechanism.
refs.factor: Prosecutor leniency (upstream filter)

refs.html: Michael Mueller-Smith; Kevin T. Schnepel (2021). Diversion in the Criminal Justice System. Review of Economic Studies 88(2): 883-936. link
refs.authors: Michael Mueller-Smith; Kevin T. Schnepel
refs.title: Diversion in the Criminal Justice System
refs.finding: Diversion halves reoffending and raises quarterly employment by nearly 50% over 10 years, concentrated among young Black men. Stigma from a felony conviction appears to be the key mechanism.
refs.factor: Diversion (deferred adjudication)

refs.html: 王金壽 (Chin-Shou Wang) (2006). 台灣的司法獨立改革與國民黨侍從主義的崩潰 (Judicial Independence Reform and the Breakdown of the Kuomintang Clientelism in Taiwan). 台灣政治學刊 (Taiwanese Political Science Review) 10(1), June 2006. Page range not shown on the journal page. Chinese page: https://www.tpsr.tw/zh-hant/zh-hant/paper/tai-wan-de-si-fa-du-li-gai-ge-yu-guo-min-dang-shi-cong-zhu-yi-de-beng-kui. link
refs.authors: 王金壽 (Chin-Shou Wang)
refs.title: 台灣的司法獨立改革與國民黨侍從主義的崩潰 (Judicial Independence Reform and the Breakdown of the Kuomintang Clientelism in Taiwan)
refs.venue: 台灣政治學刊 (Taiwanese Political Science Review) 10(1), June 2006. Page range not shown on the journal page. Chinese page: https://www.tpsr.tw/zh-hant/zh-hant/paper/tai-wan-de-si-fa-du-li-gai-ge-yu-guo-min-dang-shi-cong-zhu-yi-de-beng-kui
refs.finding: Per the Chinese abstract, under authoritarian rule the judiciary served the KMT in two ways: as a tool to control local factions, and as protection for clientelist elites' corruption and vote buying. Judicial independence reform, chiefly of case assignment and promotion in the courts and the prosecution service, had three effects. The KMT could no longer use the courts to punish factions. It could no longer shield their corruption and vote buying. And the prosecution and conviction of local politicians left a gap among KMT local elites. The abstract reports no conviction statistics.
refs.factor: Political control of the judiciary via case assignment and promotions; prosecution of vote buying and corruption by KMT local elites
refs.status: No replication or critique found in this sweep, which had no web search available.

refs.html: Chin-Shou Wang, Charles Kurzman (2007). Dilemmas of Electoral Clientelism: Taiwan, 1993. International Political Science Review 28(2): 225-245. Author PDF: http://kurzman.unc.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/1410/2011/06/Wang_Kurzman_Dilemmas.pdf. link
refs.authors: Chin-Shou Wang, Charles Kurzman
refs.title: Dilemmas of Electoral Clientelism: Taiwan, 1993
refs.venue: International Political Science Review 28(2): 225-245. Author PDF: http://kurzman.unc.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/1410/2011/06/Wang_Kurzman_Dilemmas.pdf
refs.finding: At least 45% of voters who sold their votes to the KMT did not vote for the KMT candidate. The authors attribute the leakage to four obstacles: broker scarcity, factionalism, embezzlement by brokers, and financial limits. The paper notes that vote buying was common even though it was illegal under the KMT's own legal system. It does not study courts. The author bio confirms that Wang had 'recently published an article on judicial independence reform in the Taiwanese Political Science Review'.
refs.factor: Vote buying (賄選) as the KMT's mobilisation tool; background for vote-buying prosecutions

refs.html: Christian Göbel (Goebel) (2016). The Quest for Good Governance: Taiwan's Fight Against Corruption. Journal of Democracy 27(1): 124-138. link
refs.authors: Christian Göbel (Goebel)
refs.title: The Quest for Good Governance: Taiwan's Fight Against Corruption
refs.finding: The abstract says the legal definition of corruption in Taiwan is now clearer than ever. It also says that 'since the change in ruling parties, judicial independence has been guaranteed' and anti-corruption agencies have been strengthened considerably. Corruption persists, and the agencies' institutional configuration is 'far from optimum'. The article explains these gains by the interplay of agency and institutions at democratization and at the change of ruling party.
refs.factor: Anti-corruption institutions, judicial independence, party turnover
refs.status: Essay-style peer-reviewed article. Its claims about judicial independence are not tested quantitatively.

refs.html: Tom Ginsburg (2003). Confucian Constitutionalism? The Grand Justices of the Republic of China (ch. 5 of Judicial Review in New Democracies: Constitutional Courts in Asian Cases). Cambridge University Press, pp. 106-157. link
refs.authors: Tom Ginsburg
refs.title: Confucian Constitutionalism? The Grand Justices of the Republic of China (ch. 5 of Judicial Review in New Democracies: Constitutional Courts in Asian Cases)
refs.finding: The chapter summary describes how the Council of Grand Justices, once a servant of the authoritarian regime, used careful doctrine to expand its review power incrementally. It contrasts this with a 'grand case' model of head-on confrontation with the governing powers. The chapter does not examine ordinary criminal or civil courts.
refs.jurisdiction: Taiwan (with Korea and Mongolia in the book)
refs.factor: Political environment and judicial power (constitutional court only)

refs.html: Gretchen Helmke (2002). The Logic of Strategic Defection: Court-Executive Relations in Argentina Under Dictatorship and Democracy. American Political Science Review 96(2): 291-303. link
refs.authors: Gretchen Helmke
refs.title: The Logic of Strategic Defection: Court-Executive Relations in Argentina Under Dictatorship and Democracy
refs.finding: Judges who lack independence 'strategically defect' against a government once it begins losing power. Antigovernment decisions rise significantly at the end of weak dictatorships and weak democratic governments, a 'reverse legal-political cycle'. The result holds when subsets of decisions are examined and further variables are controlled for.
refs.factor: Judges' institutional insecurity, and decisions timed to the incumbent's loss of power
refs.status: Influential. It has been extended to other countries, which this sweep did not check.

refs.html: David T. Johnson, Franklin E. Zimring (2009). The Vanguard (ch. 5 of The Next Frontier: National Development, Political Change, and the Death Penalty in Asia). Oxford University Press. link
refs.authors: David T. Johnson, Franklin E. Zimring
refs.title: The Vanguard (ch. 5 of The Next Frontier: National Development, Political Change, and the Death Penalty in Asia)
refs.finding: In South Korea and Taiwan, capital punishment has been 'highly open to change' during development and democratization, and is deeply political and symbolic. The chapter asks why executions declined rapidly in the preceding decade and whether the two countries will lead Asia toward abolition. It does not study individual sentencing decisions.
refs.factor: Politics of capital punishment, public opinion
refs.status: Academic book. Events after 2009 (resumed executions in Taiwan from 2010) post-date it.

refs.html: Marin K. Levy, Adam S. Chilton (2015). Challenging the Randomness of Panel Assignment in the Federal Courts of Appeals. Cornell Law Review 101: 1. link
refs.authors: Marin K. Levy, Adam S. Chilton
refs.title: Challenging the Randomness of Panel Assignment in the Federal Courts of Appeals
refs.finding: Only the landing page was read; the abstract and full text were not accessible, so the findings are not verified here. The title states that it challenges the assumption of random panel assignment.
refs.factor: Case and panel assignment (non-random assignment as a channel of judge selection)
refs.status: Findings not verified in this sweep

refs.html: Council of Grand Justices, Judicial Yuan (司法院大法官) (2009). 司法院釋字第665號解釋 (J.Y. Interpretation No. 665). Judicial Yuan, 16 October 2009. link
refs.corrections: Reword one sentence. 'A prosecutor's appeal against suspended detention was upheld' should read: 'The Court held that Code of Criminal Procedure art. 403(1), as far as it allows a prosecutor to appeal (抗告) a trial court's order suspending detention (停止羈押), is consistent with the right to litigate (Const. art. 16).' Optional additions: the Court dismissed the petitioner's requests for interim relief, which sought to have the case 97年度金矚重訴字第1號 tried under the 12 Dec 2008 assignment and to stop his detention. The petitioner was Chen Shui-bian (listed as 陳○扁釋憲聲請書). The holding cites Const. arts. 16 and 80.
refs.authors: Council of Grand Justices, Judicial Yuan (司法院大法官)
refs.title: 司法院釋字第665號解釋 (J.Y. Interpretation No. 665)
refs.finding: Upheld the Taipei District Court's joinder rules as consistent with the right to litigate and with independent adjudication. Under those rules, joinder is decided by consultation between the judges and approval by the court president. If the judges disagree, a panel of criminal division chiefs decides by majority vote, and only the later case's judge may request that review. The Court held that these procedures prevent arbitrary reassignment and that 'necessity of joint trial' is not unconstitutionally vague. It held that detention for a serious offence (art. 101(1)(iii)) is constitutional only if there is also a risk of flight, of destroying evidence or of collusion, and less restrictive measures would not suffice. A prosecutor's appeal against suspended detention was upheld. Justices 許宗力 and 林子儀 concurred in part and dissented in part; 許玉秀 and 李震山 dissented in part; 黃茂榮 concurred; 陳春生 concurred in part.
refs.factor: Case assignment and joinder (the right to a lawful judge, 法定法官); pretrial detention in a political case

refs.html: Wikipedia contributors (2026 (accessed)). Chen Shui-bian corruption charges (Wikipedia), with zh: 國務機要費案. Wikipedia (tertiary; cites news reports and judgments). zh page: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/國務機要費案. link
refs.authors: Wikipedia contributors
refs.title: Chen Shui-bian corruption charges (Wikipedia), with zh: 國務機要費案
refs.venue: Wikipedia (tertiary; cites news reports and judgments). zh page: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/國務機要費案
refs.finding: On 26 Dec 2008 a meeting of Taipei District Court presiding judges voted to replace Judge 周占春 (Chou Chan-chun) with 蔡守訓 (Tsai Shou-hsun). The DPP called this political intervention. Chen had been released without bail on 13 Dec 2008. After a prosecution appeal he was re-detained on 29-30 Dec, and the High Court upheld the detention on 6 Jan 2009. The outcomes were mixed. Chen was acquitted of embezzling diplomatic funds (8 Jun 2010). The Supreme Court finalised 11 years for the Longtan land case and 8 years for the office-buying case (11 Nov 2010), and remanded three other cases. On retrial in Aug 2011 the High Court acquitted him of corruption in the state affairs fund case, and the Supreme Court remanded that again in Jul 2012. A 2022 amendment to Accounting Act art. 99-1 decriminalised the state affairs fund (國務機要費) issue. The pages cite no scholarly assessments.
refs.factor: Reassignment of the judge in a politically salient trial; detention; outcomes across instances
refs.status: Tertiary source. Verify against the judgments.

refs.html: ETtoday (reporting a Facebook post by DPP legislator 段宜康) (2016). 段宜康主張廢特偵組：特偵組起訴案件定罪率 (news report of MOJ statistics). ETtoday, 21 Sep 2016. Context: zh.wikipedia 特別偵查組 (https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/特別偵查組). link
refs.corrections: Title: the exact headline is '2張圖搞懂！特偵組起訴案定罪率低　段宜康喊：廢了吧' (ETtoday政治新聞, 政治中心／綜合報導, 21 Sep 2016 15:18). Corrected finding: in a Facebook post sharing MOJ statistics, 段宜康 reported these district-court conviction rates. The SID's indictments since its founding about 10 years earlier: 48.8%. 2015 (民國104年): 11.1%. Jan-Aug 2016: 0%. The average for all district prosecutors' offices over the past decade: above 96%. The same day the LY Judiciary Committee gave first-reading approval to deleting Court Organization Act art. 63-1, with MOJ support, while KMT legislators opposed abolition. Per zh.wikipedia (最高法院檢察署特別偵查組), the SID was set up on 2 Apr 2007; art. 63-1 was deleted on 18 Nov 2016; and the SID was abolished on 1 Jan 2017. Remove 'Critics from both parties had accused it of political targeting'. The source says legislators of both parties called for abolition in 2012 because the SID failed to pursue suspected higher-ups in the 林益世 bribery case, which is a complaint about ineffectiveness, not targeting. The 2013 九月政爭 and 監聽國會事件 (SID wiretaps involving Speaker Wang Jin-pyng, DPP whip Ker Chien-ming and a Legislative Yuan line) drew accusations of abuse of power.
refs.authors: ETtoday (reporting a Facebook post by DPP legislator 段宜康)
refs.title: 段宜康主張廢特偵組：特偵組起訴案件定罪率 (news report of MOJ statistics)
refs.venue: ETtoday, 21 Sep 2016. Context: zh.wikipedia 特別偵查組 (https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/特別偵查組)
refs.finding: Over the Special Investigation Division's roughly ten years, 48.8% of its indicted cases ended in a guilty verdict at district court. The average for ordinary prosecutors' offices over the past decade was above 96%. The division's rate was 11.1% in 2015 and 0% from January to August 2016. The division was abolished on 1 Jan 2017. Critics from both parties had accused it of political targeting, including the 2013 wiretap scandal (九月政爭).
refs.factor: Outcomes of political and high-level corruption prosecutions
refs.status: Advocacy use of official data. The sample is small and the figures are first-instance only. Selection is a confounder: hard cases and well-resourced defendants. This does not show judicial bias, and could equally reflect prosecutorial overreach.

refs.html: Wikipedia contributors (2026 (accessed)). 白玫瑰運動 (925 White Rose Movement). Wikipedia (tertiary; cites judgments and news). link
refs.corrections: Title/URL: zh.wikipedia '白玫瑰運動' is a redirect to the article '925白玫瑰運動集會'. Cite that title. The '恐龍法官' sentence is not on this page. It comes from the separate zh.wikipedia article '恐龍法官', which dates the term to the 5 Aug 2010 邵燕玲 Supreme Court remand. Cite that article for it. Every other fact matches the page: Kaohsiung District Court 99年度訴字第422號 (art. 227-1, 3 years 2 months; prosecutors sought 7 years 10 months under art. 222); 5 Aug 2010 panel (邵燕玲, 李伯道, 孫增同, 李英勇, 施俊堯); 最高法院99年度第7次刑事庭會議決議 of 7 Sep 2010 (children under 7 always against their will, so art. 222); the 25 Sep 2010 march; 高雄高分院99年度上訴字第1313號 on 25 Aug 2011 (art. 222-1-2, 7 years 6 months, final without a third-instance appeal); critics' 罪刑法定 concern.
refs.authors: Wikipedia contributors
refs.title: 白玫瑰運動 (925 White Rose Movement)
refs.finding: In 2010 the Kaohsiung District Court convicted a man of sexually assaulting a 6-year-old under art. 227 (sex with a minor under 14) instead of art. 222 (aggravated forced intercourse), finding no proof the act was against her will. Prosecutors had sought 7 years 10 months; he received 3 years 2 months. On 5 Aug 2010 a Supreme Court panel presided by 邵燕玲 remanded a separate case involving a 3-year-old on similar reasoning. This produced the 恐龍法官 label. The Supreme Court's 7 Sep 2010 criminal-division resolution treats sexual acts with children under 7 as always against the victim's will, so art. 222 applies. The 925 march followed on 25 Sep 2010. On appeal the Kaohsiung case was resentenced to 7 years 6 months under art. 222 (25 Aug 2011). Critics argued the resolution conflicts with the principle of legality.
refs.factor: Public-outrage shock and the 恐龍法官 label; a legal rule change after the shock
refs.status: Tertiary source. Verify the resolution text on the Judicial Yuan site. The related zh.wikipedia 恐龍法官 page is already in another sweep.

refs.html: Wikipedia contributors (2026 (accessed)). 臺灣高等法院司法官集體收賄案 (2010 High Court judges' collective bribery case). Wikipedia (tertiary; cites 自由時報 and 蘋果日報). link
refs.corrections: (1) Per the article, the NT$8.5m (850萬) was the total that judges 陳榮和, 李春地, 蔡光治 and 房阿生 took, through 邱茂榮 and 邱創舜. It covers two fixed cases: 何智輝's 銅鑼 case (15 years reversed to an acquittal) and the bribery case of former judge 張炳龍. It was not all from 何智輝. The 何智輝 article puts his bribe to the judges at about NT$8m. (2) The article does not mention Chen Shui-bian. The 周占春 article says he twice released Chen without bail in late 2008 but does not say he was 'removed' from the case. The removal claim (the Dec 2008 case-merger and judge-change controversy) needs its own source. Confirmed as stated: detention of the four officials and two intermediaries on 15 Jul 2010; final Supreme Court judgment 102年度台上字第4200號 on 17 Oct 2013 (蔡光治 20 years, 陳榮和 18 years, 李春地 11 years 6 months, 邱茂榮 6 years); 賴英照's resignation; 正己專案 (2007) wiretaps approved by Taipei District Court judge 周占春.
refs.authors: Wikipedia contributors
refs.title: 臺灣高等法院司法官集體收賄案 (2010 High Court judges' collective bribery case)
refs.venue: Wikipedia (tertiary; cites 自由時報 and 蘋果日報)
refs.url: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/臺灣高等法院司法官集體收賄案
refs.finding: High Court judges 陳榮和, 李春地 and 蔡光治 and prosecutor 邱茂榮 were detained on 15 Jul 2010 for taking about NT$8.5 million from former legislator 何智輝, whose 15-year sentence had been reversed to an acquittal. refs.html: Wikipedia contributors (2026 (accessed)). 小燈泡事件 (2016 Neihu child murder). Wikipedia (tertiary). link
refs.corrections: Title: '小燈泡事件' redirects to '小燈泡命案'. (1) The district court (士林地院, 12 May 2017) found that the defendant's cognitive and control capacities were normal, so art. 19 did NOT apply (no exemption or reduction). It declined death only because he has schizophrenia and the two covenants, which have domestic legal effect, bar death for people with mental disorders. Corrected wording: 'found him fully responsible (art. 19 inapplicable) but declined death because...'. (2) The 10 Apr 2016 White Rose rally figure was a pre-event sign-up count ('已獲逾6萬人表示參與', over 60,000 said they would take part), not attendance. Correct as stated: 28 Mar 2016 killing (victim aged 3 years 11 months); prosecutors sought death; High Court on 3 Jul 2018 gave life plus 5 years of post-sentence custodial treatment (刑後監護5年); Supreme Court remand on 20 Dec 2018; High Court retrial on 21 Jan 2020 gave life; Supreme Court made it final on 15 Apr 2020.
refs.authors: Wikipedia contributors
refs.title: 小燈泡事件 (2016 Neihu child murder)
refs.finding: A 3-year-old was killed on 28 Mar 2016. Prosecutors sought death. The district court (12 May 2017) imposed life imprisonment: it found the defendant responsible under art. 19 but declined death because he has schizophrenia and the two UN covenants, which have domestic legal effect, bar death sentences for people with mental disorders. The High Court imposed life plus 5 years of custodial treatment (2018). The Supreme Court remanded (Dec 2018). The High Court imposed life again (Jan 2020), and the Supreme Court made it final (15 Apr 2020). A White Rose rally against abolition (10 Apr 2016) reportedly drew over 60,000 people.
refs.factor: Public-outrage and death-penalty pressure shock

refs.html: Wikipedia contributors; Central News Agency (CNA) (2026). 京華城案 (Core Pacific City case, Ko Wen-je) — detention timeline and first-instance verdict. Wikipedia plus CNA verdict report (https://www.cna.com.tw/news/asoc/202603265002.aspx, 26 Mar 2026). link
refs.authors: Wikipedia contributors; Central News Agency (CNA)
refs.title: 京華城案 (Core Pacific City case, Ko Wen-je) — detention timeline and first-instance verdict
refs.venue: Wikipedia plus CNA verdict report (https://www.cna.com.tw/news/asoc/202603265002.aspx, 26 Mar 2026)
refs.finding: Detention decisions repeatedly flipped between levels. Taipei District Court released Ko without bail on 2 Sep 2024. The High Court granted the prosecution appeal on 3-4 Sep, and the district court detained him on 5 Sep. Bail was granted on 27 Dec 2024, then reversed and remanded by the High Court on 29 Dec 2024 and again on 1 Jan 2025. He was re-detained on 2 Jan 2025 and released on NT$70m bail on 8 Sep 2025 after 363 days. On 26 Mar 2026 the district court gave 17 years in aggregate: bribery 13 years, plus counts for political donations and breach of trust. Prosecutors had sought 28.5 years. The court found NT$2.1m of bribes proven and NT$15m unproven. Co-defendants received 10 years (沈慶京) and 15.5 years (應曉薇). The TPP called it a 'political verdict'. The appeal outcome was not available in the pages read.
refs.factor: Politically salient trial; disagreement between court levels on detention; claims of political persecution
refs.status: Ongoing case. Wikipedia and CNA differ on whether any co-defendants were acquitted.

refs.html: 立法院 (Legislative Yuan), promulgated by the President (2011 (amended through 2023)). 法官法 (Judges Act): promulgated 2011-07-06, in force 2012-07-06, latest amendment 2023-12-15. 全國法規資料庫 (MOJ Laws & Regulations Database). link
refs.authors: 立法院 (Legislative Yuan), promulgated by the President
refs.title: 法官法 (Judges Act): promulgated 2011-07-06, in force 2012-07-06, latest amendment 2023-12-15
refs.venue: 全國法規資料庫 (MOJ Laws & Regulations Database)
refs.finding: These are the provisions the sweeps could not locate. Art. 73: at each year-end the court president (after consulting division chiefs and judges) rates every judge, and the Judicial Yuan approves the rating. The rating items are 學識能力、品德操守、敬業精神及裁判品質. Art. 74: a judge rated 良好 with no criminal or disciplinary sanction gets one salary step plus a bonus. Art. 9: candidate and probationary judges (候補/試署) are assessed on knowledge, dedication, ruling quality, integrity and health, with a panel reviewing their rulings; a judge who fails twice is dismissed. Arts. 5 and 7: lawyers with 6+ years of practice and professors are eligible, and non-exam entrants must pass the 法官遴選委員會. Art. 10: transfers proceed 'in the spirit of judicial self-governance', and the Judicial Yuan sets the 庭長 selection rules. Art. 11: court presidents serve 3-year terms, renewable once. Art. 30(2): grounds for individual evaluation include serious unjustified delay (item 6), serious breach of procedure (item 5) and serious ethics violations (item 7); a request about a legal opinion must be dismissed (Art. 37(4)). Art. 31 (periodic comprehensive review) has been deleted. Art. 32: triennial court-level group performance review. Art. 33: the evaluation committee has 3 judges, 1 prosecutor, 3 lawyers and 6 scholars or public members. Art. 39: the committee refers a judge to the 職務法庭 or to the 人審會. Art. 50: sanctions range from removal (免除法官職務) down to reprimand (申誡). Art. 51: other discipline requires impeachment by the Control Yuan.
refs.factor: Career pipeline: entry route, performance evaluation, evaluation and discipline

refs.html: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan) (2012 (9th version 2026)). 法官職務評定辦法 (Regulations on Judges' Annual Performance Rating), amended 2026-06-23, with 2026 修正總說明. 全國法規資料庫. link
refs.corrections: Change 'Amended 9 times since 2012' to 'amended 8 times since 2012 (the 2026-06-23 text is the 9th version)'. The 2026 修正總說明 itself says the rules were amended 7 times before 2026; the MOJ history lists the original 2012-06-26 text plus amendments in 2013, 2015 (twice), 2016, 2019, 2020, 2023 and 2026. Optional precision: 最高行政法院112年度上字第196號 held that the Judicial Yuan President has final say over ratings and, having taken part in the original rating, must recuse from re-review. The 2026 amendment therefore has the President designate a member of the 再復核委員會 as chair (Art. 25). It also lets judges go straight to 再復核 when the Judicial Yuan itself changes a rating (Art. 21). It revised 12 articles.
refs.authors: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan)
refs.title: 法官職務評定辦法 (Regulations on Judges' Annual Performance Rating), amended 2026-06-23, with 2026 修正總說明
refs.finding: The rating is binary: 良好 or 未達良好 (Art. 6). A 未達良好 rating is mandatory after a disciplinary sanction or a conviction for an intentional crime, a delay in delivering judgment originals of 4 months or more (or 360 days cumulative), repeated absence, or a full-year suspension. It is discretionary for delays of 2 to under 4 months (or 180 to under 360 days), a failed probationary review, two or more written warnings, misconduct, or an overall judgment that weighs '辦理事務期間及數量' (duration and quantity of work). The text names no clearance targets and no appeal affirmance, reversal or 折服 rates. Procedure: proposal, then preliminary rating by a 職務評定委員會 of 3–9 members (two-thirds elected by the judges being rated), then rating by the court president, then approval by the Judicial Yuan President. Remedies: 復核, then 再復核, then administrative litigation; the 職務法庭 hears claims that a rating infringes judicial independence. The 2026 amendment followed 最高行政法院112年度上字第196號, which held that the Judicial Yuan President has final say over ratings; the President must now designate another member to chair re-review, and remedies were sped up. Amended 9 times since 2012.
refs.factor: Performance evaluation and clearance incentives
refs.status: In force; individual ratings are not published

refs.html: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan) (2024). 法官遷調改任辦法 (Regulations on Transfer and Promotion of Judges), amended 2024-01-23. 全國法規資料庫. link
refs.authors: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan)
refs.title: 法官遷調改任辦法 (Regulations on Transfer and Promotion of Judges), amended 2024-01-23
refs.finding: Training cohort is written into the promotion rules. For a first transfer up to a second-instance court, the Judicial Yuan compiles candidate lists by subject area, '參酌法務部司法官學院司法官班結業期別' (with reference to the Academy cohort). Judges of the home court and the superior court vote by secret limited ballot (each voter may pick at most half the list). The local bar association recommends up to one-third. The Judicial Yuan President then proposes a list weighing 法官服務年資, 司法官班結業期別, the type of work and the 考績/職務評定 results of the last 5 years, training, and 'reference-worthy' judgments or publications. The 人審會 decides. Supreme Court posts require 12 years as a tenured judge plus a vote of that court's judges, with no bar recommendation. Ties in lateral transfers are broken by time at the court, years of service, cohort, 5 years of ratings, discipline or commendation record, and age (Art. 15). Judges with cases pending over 5 years or with repeated unimproved delays may be held back from transfer (Art. 5). Campaigning is banned.
refs.factor: Training cohort (期別), seniority, promotion incentives

refs.html: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan) (2023). 法院庭長遴任辦法 (amended 2023-12-14) and 法院庭長任期調任辦法 (amended 2023-10-26). 全國法規資料庫. link
refs.corrections: Art. 7 of 法院庭長任期調任辦法 (pcode A0030262, amended 2023-10-26) makes renewal the default. A 庭長 is renewed unless the review committee resolves not to renew, and it may do so only where a listed ground exists: rated unfit by the court president; more than 50% of that court's judges rate them unfit; more than 40% of higher-court judges rate them unfit; or concrete evidence of integrity concerns, poor dedication, poor ruling quality or improper conduct. The committee is not obliged to refuse. Ties count as approval (Art. 6). Also, bar recommendation applies only to first- and second-instance 庭長 (Art. 11). Third-instance chiefs are chosen by a vote of that court's judges only (Art. 12).
refs.authors: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan)
refs.title: 法院庭長遴任辦法 (amended 2023-12-14) and 法院庭長任期調任辦法 (amended 2023-10-26)
refs.finding: Candidate lists for 庭長 at first, second and third instance are compiled by Academy cohort (結業期別) (Arts. 11–12). An example eligibility rule: a High Court chief needs at least 1 year as a tenured judge of that court and 4 years at second instance. Anyone with discipline, a demerit (記過) or a supervisory sanction in the last 5 years is excluded (Art. 4). Judges vote by secret limited ballot and the bar association recommends; the Judicial Yuan President proposes and the 人審會 approves. Factors include cohort, seniority, 5 years of 考績/職務評定, and notable judgments or publications. Terms: a 庭長 serves 3 years, renewable once, with a Judicial Yuan extension capped at 3 years. A review committee votes by secret ballot on renewal and must refuse it if the court president rates the chief unfit, if more than 50% of the court's judges or more than 40% of higher-court judges rate the chief unfit, or if there is concrete evidence of misconduct or poor work (Art. 7).
refs.factor: Division-chief (庭長) selection and term limits; cohort

refs.html: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan) (2020 / 2025). 各級法院團體績效評比辦法 (amended 2020-10-19) and 114年 (2025) 各級法院團體績效評比結果. 全國法規資料庫; Judicial Yuan 人事專區. link
refs.authors: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan)
refs.title: 各級法院團體績效評比辦法 (amended 2020-10-19) and 114年 (2025) 各級法院團體績效評比結果
refs.venue: 全國法規資料庫; Judicial Yuan 人事專區
refs.finding: Courts, not individual judges, are scored every 3 years. Adjudication performance (50%) uses 折服率及上訴、抗告維持率 (acceptance and affirmance rates on appeal), 非常上訴撤銷件數 (extraordinary appeals reversed), mediation and settlement rates, handling of delayed cases, and 法官平均未結件數 (average pending cases per judge). Administration counts 40% and an overall assessment 10%. Results are published and serve '作為一、二審法院院長職務評定之參考' (as a reference for court presidents' own ratings). In 2025 every court scored within the 佳 band (6 to under 9 of 10), so the Judicial Yuan split the band into sub-ranges. For example, the 臺灣高等法院, its 臺中分院 and the 彰化地院 scored 8–9, while many district courts scored 7–7.5.
refs.factor: Clearance and affirmance incentives (court-level)

refs.corrections: Replace 'From 2012 to 2019 the Judicial Yuan ran a review every 3 years' with: 'The regulation (in force 2012-07-06, abolished 2019-09-23) required the Judicial Yuan to designate one year within 3 years of Art. 31 taking effect for a review, then repeat it every 3 years (Art. 2).' Whether it actually ran on that cycle is not shown by the regulation. JRF chair 黃旭田 said in 2025 only that there was '一度' (at one point) a 評核 and that it worked poorly. refs.authors: 司法院 (Judicial Yuan)
refs.title: (廢)各級法院法官評核辦法: triennial party and lawyer survey of judges, 2012–2019
refs.venue: 全國法規資料庫 (廢止法規)
refs.finding: From 2012 to 2019 the Judicial Yuan ran a review every 3 years. Parties, complainants, litigation agents and defence counsel rated each judge on a five-point scale for 問案態度 (courtroom demeanour), 訴訟程序進行情形 (conduct of proceedings), 裁判品質, 敬業精神 and 總體評價. Under Art. 8 the results were not published and served only as a reference for 職務評定. The scheme was abolished in 2019 when Judges Act Art. 31 was deleted.
